summary: Bidar userbot Kontinent AI migration bug-fix verification (backend/script only, no UI). Full pytest suite: 254/254 passed. Live script (/app/bidar/tests/live_kontinent_check.py) against the real Kontinent API: config auto-heal PASS (gemini-3-flash-preview and gpt-4o-mini reset to gemini-3.5-flash and saved to disk, claude-sonnet-5-5 kept, other keys kept); _translate_text('Hello, how are you?','fa') returned 'سلام، حال شما چطور است؟' PASS; _fetch_kontinent_models() returned all 14 live ids (cache filled from the live call, not the fallback) PASS; vision on a solid-blue PNG returned 'The dominant color is blue.' PASS; text call returned 'The capital of Kenya is Nairobi.' PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: load_config() checks ai_model against the hardcoded KONTINENT_MODELS tuple, but .aimodel accepts any id from the live /v1/models list. If Kontinent adds a new model, the user can select it, and the next restart silently resets it to gemini-3.5-flash. Today the live and hardcoded lists match exactly (14 ids), so nothing breaks now. Consider keeping the hardcoded tuple in sync or healing only on a 404.
_fetch_kontinent_models caches the list for the whole process with no TTL. That's fine, but newly added models won't appear until a restart.
_kontinent_chat always labels image data as image/jpeg, even for PNG input. It worked in this test, but strict providers may reject it.
seed_data_creation: None. The heal test used a temp CONFIG_FILE, so no real bidar_config.json was touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Not a web app. Verify with: cd /app/bidar && python -m pytest tests/ -q, then python tests/live_kontinent_check.py (needs KONTINENT_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env and network access).
